Comvi i18n 0.8.0 rebuilds the runtime. `createI18n()` returns an instance that is ready on the next line, ICU plurals and `<tag>` markup are part of every message, and loading, locale detection and the editor hook are options of `createI18n()` instead of `.use()` calls. Every binding is rebuilt on the new core, the in-context editor moves to `@comvi/editor`, and `comvi typegen` writes a new declaration. Ten packages ship at one version.

Every app changes code to upgrade. [Upgrade to 0.8](https://comvi.io/docs/i18n/guides/upgrade-to-v08) walks through it step by step; these notes list what changed, the breaking changes first, each with its 0.7 form and its 0.8 form.

## Before you upgrade

- **There are no aliases.** A 0.7 name that is listed under "Breaking changes" is gone, not deprecated.
- **Three packages get no 0.8 version.** `@comvi/plugin-fetch-loader` is now `@comvi/core/cdn`, `@comvi/plugin-locale-detector` is `@comvi/core/plugins`, and `@comvi/plugin-in-context-editor` is replaced by `@comvi/editor`, which the Comvi browser extension loads. Remove all three from `package.json`.
- **Install `@comvi/core` beside your binding** when the app imports a subpath of it, such as `@comvi/core/cdn`. `@comvi/next` now has `@comvi/core` and `@comvi/react` as peer dependencies: `npm install @comvi/next @comvi/react @comvi/core`.
- **One version everywhere.** `@comvi/core` and every binding in an app must be on the same version. With two copies of `@comvi/core` nothing fails at import; an error that names both versions is thrown, in production too, when an instance created by one copy reaches code of the other (a binding, or `@comvi/core/format`).
- **Regenerate the types.** The 0.8 declaration has another shape, so run `comvi typegen` once, or let `comviTypes()` rewrite the file.
- **A visitor's stored locale is not found unless you name its key.** The 0.7 detector stored the choice in `localStorage` under `i18n_locale` by default, or in the cookie `i18n_lang` with `caches: ["cookie"]`, and read the `?lng=` query. `detect()` with its defaults reads `?lang=` and one name, `comvi_locale`, for both the cookie and `localStorage`, and `persist()` writes a cookie, so a returning visitor's choice is not found: `detect()` goes on to the browser's languages and starts in the first one the app supports, or in the `locale` option when it supports none of them. `sessionStorage` is no longer a source. This keeps reading and writing the 0.7 `localStorage` choice:

  ```ts
  createI18n({
    locale: "en",
    plugins: [
      detect({ supported: ["en", "uk"], query: "lng", key: "i18n_locale" }),
      persist({ to: "storage", key: "i18n_locale" }),
    ],
  });
  ```

  [Keep a stored locale choice](https://comvi.io/docs/i18n/guides/upgrade-to-v08#keep-a-stored-locale-choice) has the cookie case.

- **The browser extension must be the release for 0.8.** It drives only a site on `@comvi/core` 0.8 or newer with `plugins: [devtools()]`; on a site with an older Comvi its popup says so and does not offer the editor.
- **Version floors.** `@comvi/next` needs Next.js `^15.5.29 || ^16.4.5` and React 19.3.1 or newer, App Router only. `@comvi/vue` needs Vue 3.5 or newer (`^3.5.0`, where 0.7 took `^3.0.0`). `@comvi/nuxt` needs Nuxt `^3.7.0 || ^4.0.0` (0.7 took `^3.0.0 || ^4.0.0`) and Node 22.20 or newer.

## Breaking changes: `@comvi/core`

**No `init()`.** The instance is built synchronously. With a loader, the first loads start inside `createI18n()` and `ready` resolves when they have settled.

```diff
 const i18n = createI18n({ locale: "en", messages });
-await i18n.init();
+await i18n.ready; // only when a loader is configured
```

**No `.use()`.** Capabilities are options of `createI18n()`.

```diff
-import { createI18n } from "@comvi/core";
-import { icuCompiler } from "@comvi/core/icu";
-import { cdnLoader } from "@comvi/plugin-fetch-loader";
-import { localeDetector } from "@comvi/plugin-locale-detector";
-import { devtools } from "@comvi/core/devtools";
-
-const i18n = createI18n({ locale: "en", compiler: icuCompiler })
-  .use(cdnLoader({ cdnUrl: "https://cdn.comvi.io/<project-token>" }))
-  .use(localeDetector())
-  .use(devtools());
+import { createI18n } from "@comvi/core";
+import { cdn } from "@comvi/core/cdn";
+import { detect, persist } from "@comvi/core/plugins";
+import { devtools } from "@comvi/core/devtools";
+
+const i18n = createI18n({
+  locale: "en",
+  loader: cdn("https://cdn.comvi.io/<project-token>"),
+  plugins: [detect({ supported: ["en", "uk"] }), persist(), devtools()],
+});
```

- **ICU is always on.** `compiler: icuCompiler` and the import of `@comvi/core/tags` are gone: `plural`, `selectordinal`, `select`, `=N`, `offset:`, `#` and `<tag>…</tag>` are read in every message. `{x, number}`, `{x, date}` and `{x, time}` are not part of the syntax: the message renders its key and `onError` receives `syntax`. Format the value with `@comvi/core/format` (or a binding's `useFormat()`) and pass it as a plain `{x}`.
- **A custom loader is the `loader` option**, `(locale, ns, signal) => Promise<catalog>`, in place of `.use(loader(map))` from `@comvi/core/loader`. It returns the catalog itself: for a JSON module, `return module.default`. `i18n.registerLoader()`, `createImportMapLoader()` and `attachLoader()` are gone with it, and `onLoadError(fn)` is the `onError` option with the code `load_failed`.
- **Subpaths.** Removed: `@comvi/core/loader`, `/icu`, `/rich-text`, `/tags` and `/editor-bridge`. New: `/cdn`, `/format` and `/ssr`. `/plugins` and `/devtools` keep their names with new contents. The `<script>` global build (`ComviCore`) is gone; the package is ESM only.
- **`on(fn)` takes one listener.** It runs on every change the instance publishes and returns the unsubscribe function. The named events of `on(event, fn)` (`localeChanged`, `namespaceLoaded`, `missingKey`, `loadError` and the rest) are gone; a development build throws a `TypeError` when `on()` gets an event name. Problems arrive through the `onError` option as `missing_key`, `missing_param`, `syntax`, `load_failed`, `invalid_locale` or `fallback_used`.
- **`locale` is read-only**, and assigning it throws a `TypeError`. Switch with `await i18n.setLocale("uk")`. It keeps the current locale on screen while the new one loads, and rejects only when no namespace it waited for has a catalog from the new locale's own chain (`de-AT`, then its parent `de`).
- **`load(ns)` rejects with the loader's error** when the locale's own load of that namespace failed and no catalog of the namespace from the locale's own chain (`de-AT`, then its parent `de`) is in place; a `fallbackLocale`'s catalog does not count. Calling it again calls the loader again. `ready` never rejects.
- **`defaultParams` is gone**, with `setDefaultParams()`. Pass the params to each `t()` call; generated types make every param a message uses required.
- **A plain `{name}` is always text.** A React element, a Vue VNode or a function passed there prints `String(value)`. Markup comes from tags: `Hello, <strong>{name}</strong>!` with a handler or a `components` entry for `strong`.
- **Formatters are imported from `@comvi/core/format`**, no longer from `@comvi/core`; they take the instance first, as in 0.7: `formatNumber(i18n, 1234.5)`. `formatRelativeTime(i18n, value, unit)` is now `formatRelativeTime(i18n, date, { now })`: it takes a date and picks the unit.
- **`devtools()` takes no options.** `instanceId`, `exposeGlobal` and `editorVersion` are gone, with the `instanceId` on the instance.
- **`cdn(url, { fallback })`.** A `fallback` entry returns the catalog itself, as a loader does: `en: () => import("./locales/en.json").then((m) => m.default)`.
- **An invalid `locale` option throws a `RangeError`** from `createI18n()`. Match a locale from a URL, cookie or header against your supported locales first; `negotiate()` does it.
- **Renamed options and members**, each as its 0.7 form, then its 0.8 form:
  - `new I18n(options)` → `createI18n(options)`. `I18n` is exported as a type only.
  - `messages: { "en:account": { … } }` → `catalogs: { account: { en: { … } } }`. `messages` holds the `default` namespace only, keyed by locale. A `"locale:namespace"` key is not read as a namespace: its text is not found, and `onError` receives `invalid_locale`.
  - `createI18n({ ns: ["account"] })` → `namespaces: ["account"]`. `defaultNs` is gone: `t()` without `{ ns }` reads `default`.
  - `onMissingKey: (info) => …` → `missing: (key, locale, ns) => string`.
  - `i18n.addMessages({ en: { … } })` → `i18n.add("en", { … })`, with the namespace as the third argument.
  - `i18n.hasTranslation(key, locale, ns)` → `i18n.has(key, { locale, ns })`.
  - `i18n.addActiveNamespace(ns)` → `await i18n.load(ns)`, which loads the namespace for the current locale and does not keep it for a later switch.
  - `.use(definePlugin((i18n) => { … }))` → `plugins: [{ name: "…", setup(i18n) { … } }]`. The function `setup` returns runs on `destroy()`.
  - `getTextDirection(locale)` → `i18n.dir`, the direction of the current locale.
- **Gone from the instance and the options:** `tRaw()`, `clearMessages()`, `getMessages()`, `hasLocale()`, `setFallbackLocale()`, `setDefaultNamespace()`, the `isLoading`, `isInitializing` and `isInitialized` flags, and the options `postProcess`, `missingParam`, `strict`, `tagInterpolation`, `devMode`, `apiKey` and `collectContext`. [Upgrade to 0.8](https://comvi.io/docs/i18n/guides/upgrade-to-v08) lists each one, with what to write instead where something replaces it.
- **Gone with no replacement:** `withMessages()` (there is no read view over an instance; `add()` writes the instance itself), `reloadMessages()` (`load(ns)` asks again only for a catalog whose load failed, and a loaded catalog is not fetched again), `removeActiveNamespace()`, `getActiveNamespaces()`, `getLoadedLocales()`, `getDefaultNamespace()` (the default namespace is always `default`), `getFallbackLocales()` with the `fallbackLocales` getter, `reportError()`, and the exports `flattenCatalog()` (a nested catalog is accepted wherever a catalog is), `createElement()`, `isVirtualNode()` and `translationResultToString()`, which served `tRaw()`.

## Breaking changes: the bindings

Each binding's README has the full 0.8 setup. The root of `@comvi/react`, `@comvi/vue`, `@comvi/svelte` and `@comvi/solid` no longer re-exports the core's helpers: `devtools` is imported from `@comvi/core/devtools` and the formatters from `@comvi/core/format`, while `loader`, `plugins`, `definePlugin` and `icuCompiler` are gone with the core subpaths they came from. Each root still exports `createI18n`. In React, Vue, Svelte and Solid, `useI18n(ns?)` returns `t`, `T`, `locale`, `dir`, `isReady`, `isLoading`, `setLocale` and the instance.

- **`@comvi/react`.** `<I18nProvider fallback>` is now `<I18nProvider loading>` (or `suspense`), and it gates the first paint only. `useFormatters()` is `useFormat()` from `@comvi/react/format`. `useI18nInstance`, `useIsLoading`, `useI18nLoader`, `useI18nPlugins` and `useSetLocaleTransition` are gone: `useI18n()` returns the instance and the flags. `<I18nHandover>` hands a server render's catalogs to the browser.
- **`@comvi/vue`.** `createApp(App).use(i18n)` stays, as Vue's own plugin call. `locale` from `useI18n()` is a writable ref, and a failed switch through it is reported to `onError`, never thrown. `<T :components>` renders tags by name. `useI18nLoader()`, `useI18nPlugins()`, `createI18nFromCore()`, `I18N_INJECTION_KEY` and the `ssrLocale` option are gone: a server creates an instance per request with the request's `locale`.
- **`@comvi/svelte`.** Runes replace stores: `setI18nContext(i18n)` is `setI18n(i18n)`, and `{$t("hi")}` is `{t("hi")}`. `t()` always returns a string; rich text goes through `<T>` with `components` or a snippet named after the tag, and with generated types `t()` refuses a key whose message has tags. `useI18nInstance()`, `useI18nLoader()`, `useI18nPlugins()` and the store factories (`createLocaleStore()` and the others) are gone, and `@comvi/svelte/format` exports `useFormat()` in place of the four format functions.
- **`@comvi/solid`.** `<I18nProvider i18n loading?>`; `locale`, `dir`, `isReady` and `isLoading` from `useI18n()` are accessors. `useI18nInstance()`, `useI18nLoader()`, `useI18nPlugins()` and the signal factories (`createLocaleSignal()` and the others) are gone.
- **`@comvi/next`.** `createNextI18n()` is gone. `createGetI18n({ locales, defaultLocale, timeZone, loader })` from `@comvi/next/server` returns the app's `getI18n()`, with an instance per request, and the server `<I18nProvider>` hands the request's catalogs to Client Components. The root entry `@comvi/next` and `@comvi/next/config` are gone. `@comvi/next/server` exports `createGetI18n` and `I18nProvider` only: `<ComviProvider>` is `<I18nProvider i18n routing>`, and its `getI18n()`, `getLocale()`, `setRequestLocale()`, `loadMessages()`, `setI18n()` and `createNextI18nFromInstance()` are gone: your own `getI18n({ locale })` loads the request's catalogs and returns `t`, `locale`, `dir` and `i18n`. `@comvi/next/client` exports `I18nProvider` only: `useI18n()`, `<T>` and `useLocale()` come from `@comvi/react`, and `useFormat()` from `@comvi/react/format`.
- **`@comvi/nuxt`.** The data go to `comvi` in `nuxt.config`, where `timeZone` is now required, and the functions go to `comvi.i18n.ts`, whose default export is `defineI18nOptions(() => ({ loader, onError, missing, plugins }))` in place of the `defineComviI18n()` instance factory. `comvi.ns` is renamed `comvi.namespaces`, and `comvi.icu` is gone with the compiler option. Gone too: `comvi.setup.ts` with `defineComviSetup()` and the `@comvi/nuxt/setup` entry (its work moves into `comvi.i18n.ts`); the Nitro auto-imports `loadMessages()`, `getRequestI18n()` and `getServerRuntimeConfig()` (`useTranslation(event)` returns the request's `i18n`, and Nitro's own `useRuntimeConfig(event)` reads the config); `hasTranslation` on the result of `useTranslation()`, which now has `t`, `locale`, `dir` and `i18n` (ask `i18n.has(key, { ns })`); the auto-imports `useI18nLoader()` and `useI18nPlugins()`; and the exports `createI18n`, `loader`, `plugins`, `definePlugin` and `icuCompiler` of `@comvi/nuxt/i18n`.

## Breaking changes: the editor and the tooling

- **In-context editor.** The app no longer installs an editor package or holds an API key. It composes `plugins: [devtools()]`, and the Comvi browser extension loads `@comvi/editor` onto the page. `inContextEditor()`, `inContextEditorPlugin()` and the npm mode are gone. The editor sends no usage context to the platform in this release.
- **`comvi typegen`** writes `interface Catalogs` of the Comvi package your app declares, one member per namespace, with each key's params. New: `--from <dir>` and `--from .comvi/schema.json` generate offline with no key, and `comvi pull` writes that schema file. A `defaultParams` field in `.comvirc.json` is refused. In code, `@comvi/cli` exports `generate()` and `watch()` in place of `TypeGenerator`, `TypeEmitter`, the reporters and the file-system classes.
- **`@comvi/vite-plugin`.** `comviTypes({ translations, output })` is `comviTypes({ from, out })`. `defaultNs` and `strictParams` are gone: namespaces are members of `Catalogs`, and every param is required.
- **An app whose `package.json` lists `@comvi/next` and neither `@comvi/react` nor `@comvi/core`** is refused by the three generators, because `@comvi/next` has no root module to augment. Install both beside it, as its install line says.

## New

- **Nested catalogs.** `{ "account": { "greeting": "…" } }` is the key `account.greeting`, the same key as `{ "account.greeting": "…" }`, wherever a catalog is accepted. Nesting groups keys; it creates no namespace.
- **`@comvi/core/cdn`.** `cdn(url, { fallback })` takes bundled catalogs for when the CDN does not answer. `createCatalogStore()` lets the instances of a server process share fetched catalogs, and `api(base, { key })` reads the platform API from a server or a script.
- **`@comvi/core/ssr`.** `handover(i18n)` is what a server render hands the browser: the locale, the time zone, the clock and the catalogs, in the shape `createI18n()` takes.
- **`i18n.ns(name)`** returns `t()` bound to a namespace: `i18n.ns("shop")("title")`.
- **Typed namespace names.** With generated types, `useI18n("acount")`, `i18n.ns("acount")` and their server forms are type errors that list the declared namespaces.
- **An opening tag that is never closed renders as text.** `a<br>b` renders `a<br>b`, where it rendered the key; write `<br/>` for an empty tag. A development build warns, and `comvi check` reports it as an `unclosed tag` warning.
- **`@comvi/next`.** `getAlternates(routing, { locale, href })` returns a page's canonical and hreflang paths for `generateMetadata`; set `metadataBase`, or Next.js leaves them relative. `withComvi({ types })` writes the declaration while `next.config` loads.
- **`@comvi/nuxt`.** `comvi.types` writes the declaration into `.nuxt/types`. It needs Nuxt 3.21.11 or newer, or 4.6.0 or newer.

## Things to know

- **`messages` beside `loader`.** An inline catalog switches off loading for its pair of locale and namespace: with `messages: { en }`, the loader is never called for `en` and `default`, while the other namespaces of `en` and every other locale still load. A `cdn()` `fallback` is a spare for when the CDN does not answer, not a base the CDN lays over.
- **Without a framework, `load(ns)` does not follow a switch.** After `await i18n.setLocale("uk")`, call `await i18n.load(ns)` again. A binding's `useI18n(ns)` does it for you.
- **The limits of this release** are on [Limitations](https://comvi.io/docs/i18n/limitations).

## Speed

Measured with `node scripts/perf.mjs --compare-ref v0.7.1 --repetitions 3` on the 0.8 source (commit `1c73fe09`) against the `v0.7.1` tag, on Node 24.22.1. The command ran twice; each cell is the median of three repetitions, in microseconds per call, 0.7.1 → 0.8:

| Case                                         | First run     | Second run    |
| -------------------------------------------- | ------------- | ------------- |
| `t()` of a static key                        | 0.018 → 0.011 | 0.019 → 0.011 |
| `t()` with `{name}`                          | 0.053 → 0.052 | 0.055 → 0.054 |
| `t()` of an ICU plural                       | 0.394 → 0.354 | 0.416 → 0.356 |
| `t()` of a message with a `<b>` tag          | 0.246 → 0.199 | 0.249 → 0.204 |
| `add()` of one key over a 10,000-key catalog | 2,318 → 1.38  | 2,432 → 1.44  |
| `formatNumber`                               | 0.346 → 0.368 | 0.342 → 0.377 |
| `formatDate`                                 | 0.555 → 0.584 | 0.570 → 0.592 |
| `formatRelativeTime`                         | 0.366 → 0.402 | 0.360 → 0.412 |
| `createI18n()` over a 200-key catalog        | 5.35 → 9.27   | 5.45 → 9.30   |

Two things got slower. The formatters cost 4 % to 14 % more per call. `createI18n()` costs about 70 % more over a 200-key inline catalog, because the instance now checks every catalog it accepts for nested groups, one pass over its keys; the cost grows with the number of keys.
